text: つかまえるのが　むずかしいけど　うまく　そだてりゃ　つよさは　てんか　いっぴんだ　からだも　じょうぶ　だし　こてさきの　こうげきも　むださ！

structure.jp: つかまえるのが　むずかしいけど
うまく　そだてりゃ
つよさは　てんか　いっぴんだ
structure.en: their strength is second to none

structure.jp: からだも　じょうぶ　だし
structure.en: their bodies are tough too, and

structure.jp: こてさきの　こうげきも　むださ！

patterns.name: 〜ば
patterns.explanation: ば on a verb means 'if'. そだてりゃ is the slurred spoken form of そだてれば. うまく そだてりゃ = 'if you raise them well'.

patterns.name: 〜の (nominalizer)
patterns.explanation: の after a verb turns the action into a thing you can talk about, like '-ing'. つかまえるのが むずかしい = 'catching them is hard'.

patterns.name: 〜し
patterns.explanation: し after a statement adds it as one reason among several, like 'and what's more'. からだも じょうぶ だし = 'their bodies are tough too, and'.
